**Progress, Potential, and Possibilities with Starfighters Space.**


For decades, getting to space has largely meant one thing: launching vertically atop massive rockets from fixed launch pads. But what if the future of space access also includes aircraft capable of flying at more than twice the speed of sound, launching payloads from the edge of the atmosphere, and providing researchers with affordable access to hypersonic flight and microgravity?


Joining us today is Tim Franta, Chief Executive Officer of Starfighters Space…
